name: YT Thumbnail
tagline: YouTube thumbnails at 1280×720 — generate, remix your own image, then overlay the text.
description:
YT Thumbnail makes YouTube thumbnails at exactly 1280×720 without you ever touching an aspect-ratio setting.

Generate — describe the thumbnail and get up to four 16:9 candidates in one run. The aspect is locked, so nothing comes back the wrong shape or needs cropping afterwards.

Remix — start from an image you already have. Feed in a frame from your video or an earlier thumbnail and steer it with a prompt, keeping the composition you liked.

Edit — drop a candidate into the built-in canvas editor and lay big, readable text over it. Positioning, sizing and line-wrapping are handled for you, and the export walks JPEG quality down until the file fits YouTube's 2 MB thumbnail cap — so what you download is always uploadable.

Generations spend your own Buzz. Every run shows a cost estimate and waits for you to confirm before it submits.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Runs image generations on the user's behalf, spending from the per-generation Buzz budget the page grants.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Loads the thumbnail formats this viewer saved earlier, so their own formats are on the picker when they come back.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves, edits and deletes the viewer's own thumbnail formats. They stay private to that viewer unless they explicitly publish one.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists the formats other viewers chose to publish, with their vote totals, so a viewer can browse and use a community format.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Publishes a format the viewer chose to share, and casts their votes and abuse reports on published formats.
